sports.headline: Norris wins wet São Paulo GP as Mercedes clinch 2026 Constructors' Championship
sports.summary: Lando Norris beat Max Verstappen in a wet São Paulo Grand Prix. Verstappen climbed to second from 21st on the grid, and Red Bull's Isack Hadjar made it a double podium. Fourth and fifth places for George Russell and Kimi Antonelli were enough to give Mercedes the Constructors' title.

sports.headline: WTA Finals open at Indian Wells without defending champion Rybakina
sports.summary: The season-ending WTA Finals began on 8 November at Indian Wells for the first time. Reigning champion Elena Rybakina withdrew through illness and was replaced by first alternate Marta Kostyuk. Linda Nosková won her opener against Kostyuk and Coco Gauff beat Jessica Pegula in a three-set match.

sports.headline: Claire Liu wins first WTA title as Alex Eala, now set for a career-high world No.15, is beaten in the Hong Kong Open final
sports.summary: World No.102 Claire Liu beat second seed Alex Eala 6-3, 6-0 in Hong Kong for her first tour title. Eala was dealing with a knee problem. She had become the first Filipino to win a WTA title in August. She is set to reach a career-high ranking of No.15 on Monday after a breakout season.
